text: The system shall define and enforce the permitted asset fields that Users may edit during an asset modification and shall allow the modification to be submitted for validation and approval.
The system shall stage validated asset modifications in a pending-approval state until an Admin approves or rejects the change.

The system shall define and apply documented matching rules for asset detail searches by name, type, and ID, specifying whether each criterion is matched exactly, partially, and/or case-insensitively.
The system shall define whether asset detail queries accept a single search criterion or a combination of name, type, and ID.
The system shall return a defined empty-result response when no asset matches the supplied search criteria.
The system shall return a defined complete set of asset detail fields for each matching asset record, including at least name, type, quantity, purchase date, and status.
The system shall provide an admin operation to reject a staged deletion request and update its status to rejected.
The system shall define and implement the handling of valid imported asset records that match an existing asset, specifying whether such records are created, updated, skipped, or rejected.

The system shall validate asset requests against documented criteria, including required name, type, quantity, and purpose, and shall handle validation failures by rejecting or routing the request for correction before staging it for admin approval.
The system shall define and document which event types trigger automatic email notifications, including event types beyond registration and profile updates.
The system shall support resending a Sent Email when delivery is later reported as failed, preserving the original Sent Email record and logging the new resend attempt.
The system shall sort asset change history query results by change time in descending order by default.
The system shall allow users to filter asset change history by any combination of asset ID, change type, and change date.
The system shall allow users to filter asset change history by a change date range using start and end dates when provided.
The system shall define and maintain an enumeration of allowed change type values used for filtering asset change history, and shall restrict the change type filter to those defined values.
The system shall define and support the matching behavior for Category Name in asset category queries.
The system shall provide both approval and rejection outcomes for senior-admin review of staged category changes, and shall not apply the category update when the senior admin rejects it.
